# origincloud_network_route_table_association (Resource)

The route table a subnet uses.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) The project the route table association is in. Changing it replaces the route table association.
- `route_table` (String) The route table the subnet uses, in the subnet's VPC. Changing it replaces the route table association.
- `subnet` (String) The subnet the route table association is in. Changing it replaces the route table association.
- `zone` (String) The zone the route table association is in. Changing it replaces the route table association.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The route table association's resource name, the same as `name`.
- `name` (String) The association's resource name. Its last segment is the route table's id.
